UPDATE deals  -- was loans
        SET
            principal_amount = $2,
            outstanding_balance = $3,
            interest_rate_bps = $4,
            deal_status = $5,
            maturity_date = $6,
            custom_deal_id = $8,
            status = $9,
            title = $10,
            description = $11,
            risk_level = $12,
            asset_class = $13,
            region = $14,
            minimum_investment = $15,
            updated_at = $7
        WHERE id = $1
